segments.name: Transportation services
segments.description: Provides temperature-controlled truckload and urban delivery transportation services to customers in China, charged by mileage.
segments.evidence: The Company concludes that it has only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company by mileage for temperature-controlled truckload transportation and urban delivery services.
revenueModel.evidence: We mainly provide transportation services with our large and medium-sized temperature-controlled logistics transportation vehicles, and charge our customers based on mileage.

changes.text: In 2025 the company disposed of its urban delivery subsidiaries Haiyue and Longanda.
changes.evidence: Upon completion of the disposal, Haiyue and Longanda were deconsolidated from our financial statements.
